newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks little changed in early morning.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks little changed in early morning.

text.p: Tokyo stocks stood little changed in early morning trade on Monday, after opening slightly higher.
The market was supported by steadiness in U.S. stocks on Friday and the dollar's recent stability against the yen, but losses in brokerages weighed on the key index.
After 11 minutes of trade, the 225-share Nikkei average was down 1.50 points or 0.01 percent at 20,067.31. June Nikkei futures were unchanged at 20,140.
"The index is somewhat directionless," said a broker at a second-tier Japanese securities house.
